memory_candidates.content: When a documentation-only implementation task edits a file with pre-existing defects unrelated to the task's scope (e.g. a stale non-JSON fenced block, or pre-existing citations the deliverable rule would normally forbid), don't silently fix or silently ignore them. Instead, isolate exactly what the current task's edits introduced by running `git diff <pre-task-commit>..HEAD -- <file> | grep '^+'` and checking only the added lines against the constraint. This distinguishes 'my new content is clean' from 'the whole file is clean', letting verification pass honestly while leaving out-of-scope pre-existing issues untouched per the plan's Non-Goals, and documents the finding in the deviation/summary rather than papering over it.
